세계보건기구에 따르면 콩고는 10월 20일 기준 확진자 9,704명, 사망자 4,687명을 기록했다.

아프리카 일부 지역에서 치명적인 발병을 일으키고 있는 에볼라 변종에 대한 백신 임상시험이 콩고민주공화국에서 시작됐다. 콩고민주공화국은 이번 유행의 발원지이며 대다수의 확진자와 사망자가 발생한 곳이다.

첫 번째 참가자는 지난 금요일 콩고 동부 부니아에서 머크앤드컴퍼니의 에르베보 백신을 접종받았다. 에르베보는 다른 에볼라 종에 대해 승인된 백신이다. 모더나와 옥스퍼드대학교, 인도 세럼연구소가 공동 개발한 분디부교 변종 전용 실험용 백신도 수주 내에 이 임상시험에서 테스트될 수 있다.

전염병대비혁신연합 최고경영자 리처드 해처트는 "유행이 통제되지 않고 있기 때문에 우리가 기회의 창을 가지고 있다고 상당히 확신한다"고 말했다.

**러시아 이르쿠츠크주 페스트 사망 사건, 미국도 주시**

러시아 이르쿠츠크주 보건당국이 페스트 연구소 직원의 사망 이후 방역 조치를 시작했다.

도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 국무부가 러시아 페스트 연구실과 관련된 "원인 불명의 폐렴" 사망 사례를 모니터링하고 있다고 발표한 후 미국이 러시아를 돕기 위해 준비되어 있다고 밝혔다.

트럼프 대통령은 월요일 기자들에게 "그런 종류의 문제가 있는 누구든지 우리는 항상 도울 준비가 되어 있다"고 말했다.

미국이 러시아로부터 오는 위험을 완화하기 위해 어떻게 계획하고 있는지 묻는 질문에 트럼프는 자신의 행정부가 "이를 매우 강하게 검토하고 있다"고 답했다.

트럼프는 이 발병을 "폐렴 페스트"라고 부르며, 폐렴을 "심각한 질병"이라고 설명했고, "그 미생물들은 더 강해지고 더 똑똑해졌다. 그들은 군대 같다"고 덧붙였다.

일요일 국무부 대변인은 성명을 통해 "우리는 러시아 이르쿠츠크주에서 의심되는 폐렴 페스트 사망 사례 보도를 인지하고 있다. 우리는 상황을 모니터링하고 있다"고 밝혔다.

titleKo: 모데르나, DRC 발병 배후 균주에 대한 에볼라 백신 1상 임상 시험 시작 - ABC 뉴스
body:
Moderna said on Tuesday it has begun a Phase 1 clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine set to target the Bundibugyo strain, which is currently circulating in the eastern DRC.
The first phase will evaluate the safety and tolerability of the vaccine.
Moderna has begun a Phase 1 clinical trial of an Ebola vaccine set to target the Bundibugyo strain, which is currently circulating in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), the pharmaceutical company announced Tuesday.
The first participants were vaccinated in Canada with the candidate, mRNA-1469. The vaccine will be using the same mRNA platform that Moderna used to develop its vaccine during the COVID-19 pandemic.
The first phase of the clinical trial will evaluate the safety and tolerability of the vaccine, with about 80 participants.
If warranted, a Phase 2 and Phase 3 trial will follow. Any approval and subsequent delivery of the vaccine would be months, if not years, away.

모데르나는 화요일 현재 동부 콩고에서 유통되고 있는 분디부교 균주를 표적으로 설정된 에볼라 백신에 대한 1상 임상 시험을 시작했다고 밝혔다.
첫 번째 단계에서는 백신의 안전성과 내약성을 평가합니다.
모데르나 (Moderna) 는 현재 콩고 민주 공화국 동부 (DRC) 에서 유통되고 있는 분디부교 균주를 표적으로 설정된 에볼라 백신에 대한 1상 임상 시험을 시작했다고 제약 회사가 화요일 발표했다.
첫 번째 참가자는 후보 mRNA-1469와 함께 캐나다에서 예방 접종을 받았다. 이 백신은 Moderna가 COVID-19 대유행 기간 동안 백신을 개발하는 데 사용한 것과 동일한 mRNA 플랫폼을 사용할 것입니다.
임상 시험의 첫 번째 단계에서는 약 80명의 참가자가 백신의 안전성과 내약성을 평가합니다.
보증이 있는 경우, 2상 및 3상 시험이 뒤따를 것입니다. 백신의 승인 및 후속 전달은 몇 년이 아니라면 몇 개월이 걸릴 것입니다.

13 October 2026, Aden/Cairo, Yemen/Egypt – Escalating conflict and mass displacement in Yemen are increasing the risk of infectious disease outbreaks as overcrowding, inadequate access to safe water and disrupted health services expose growing numbers of people to cholera, measles and other preventable diseases.
The latest escalation, which began on 6 August, has displaced over 200 000 people across 10 governorates, coinciding with a sharp increase in cholera transmission.
Suspected cholera cases have tripled in three weeks, rising from 217 in epidemiological week 36 to 647 in week 39. Yemen has reported 8034 suspected cases and 27 deaths this year, with a quarter of cases occurring in the last four weeks.

Switzerland says patient is wife of Swiss diplomat and believed to have contracted virus while travelling in Uganda
Health officials across Africa are racing to determine how Nigeria’s first Ebola patient ⁠in more than a decade ⁠became infected, amid fears ​the outbreak could spread further after reaching a fourth African country.
The Swiss foreign ministry said on Friday the patient in Nigeria, the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja, had not travelled to the Democratic Republic of ⁠Congo, where the outbreak was first detected in mid-May before spreading to Uganda , Kenya and now Nigeria. The woman was believed to have contracted Ebola while travelling with her husband in Uganda, the ministry added.
The new information contradicts accounts from Uganda, which previously said the woman had travelled to eastern DR Congo, and will raise concerns about the ability of authorities to contain the outbreak, which is already the most geographically widespread in history.

titleKo: 케냐와 나이지리아의 첫 번째 에볼라 사례가 교차했는지 여부를 조사하는 당국
body:
Nigeria this week recorded its first case of Ebola in the current outbreak, which has spread from the epicenter in Congo to several other African countries.
Threads Facebook Twitter Pinterest Bluesky LinkedIn Email JOHANNESBURG – The first Ebola patient confirmed in Nigeria may have crossed paths with the first Kenyan Ebola patient at a Ugandan airport, health officials said Thursday.
Nigeria announced its first case of Ebola in more than a decade on Tuesday. Nigerian health authorities said the patient is the Ugandan-born wife of a diplomat based in Abuja who had vacationed in Uganda in September and returned to Nigeria earlier this month.
She is being treated and 44 people she had close contact with have been quarantined, Dr. Wessam Mankoula, head of emergency preparedness and response at the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, told a press briefing on Thursday.

titleKo: 나이지리아 케냐에서 발생한 에볼라 사례로 우간다의 계정이 면밀한 조사를 받고 있습니다.
body:
Copy link Advertisement The first confirmed Ebola patients in Kenya and Nigeria may have crossed paths at Uganda's Entebbe International Airport, according to African health officials, as new information from Switzerland contradicts Uganda's account of the Nigerian patient's travel history.
Uganda , a country reporting no active Ebola infections, has become a focus of investigations into cases thousands of kilometers apart.
Uganda insists it has no confirmed active cases of the deadly virus . Yet health authorities in Kenya and Nigeria are investigating Ebola infections involving people whose travel histories or contacts are connected to the East African nation.
Both patients passed through Entebbe International Airport on October 3, according to Wessam Mankoula, head of emergency preparedness and response at the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) .

우간다에서는 치명적인 바이러스의 활성 사례가 확인되지 않았다고 주장합니다. 그러나 케냐와 나이지리아의 보건 당국은 여행 기록이나 연락처가 동아프리카 국가와 관련된 사람들과 관련된 에볼라 감염을 조사하고 있습니다.

titleKo: WFP가 식량을 공급하고, 치료 센터를 건설하고, 보급품을 계속 공급함에 따라 에볼라가 8번째 콩고 지방으로 확산됨
body:
KINSHASA, Democratic Republic of the Congo – As Ebola spreads to an eighth province in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), affected families face growing difficulty accessing food while following treatment and isolation guidance. In a response already challenged by conflict, hunger and access constraints, the United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) is delivering food assistance, building Ebola Treatment Centres and providing the logistics, telecommunications and air services that enable health partners to reach affected communities.
Families should not have to choose between following health guidance and finding food. WFP’s food and nutrition assistance supports patients and families during treatment or isolation, reduces the pressure to move in search of food and helps frontline health teams keep working. WFP’s common services move responders and essential supplies to areas where insecurity and poor roads constrain access.

titleKo: 나이지리아에서 에볼라에 감염된 여성이 스위스 외교관의 부인으로 확인됨
body:
Her husband is currently in isolation but has not developed any symptoms, Swiss officials say.
Share Save Add as preferred on Google Simi Jolaoso , Africa correspondent , Makuochi Okafor , BBC Africa, Lagos and Wycliffe Muia Switzerland's foreign ministry has confirmed that the woman who has tested positive for Ebola in Nigeria is the wife of a Swiss diplomat.
The woman, a 42-year-old Ugandan-born national who lives in the Nigerian capital, Abuja, tested positive for the virus on 20 October, becoming the country's first confirmed Ebola patient in more than a decade.
They both travelled to Uganda earlier this month. Her husband is currently in isolation but has not developed any symptoms, according to the Swiss foreign ministry.
The ministry told the BBC that all 25 staff at its embassy in Nigeria were in good health and did not need to isolate.

titleKo: 대륙 전역의 에볼라 위기 위험에 처한 아프리카, 보건 책임자가 경고하다
body:
African governments are preparing a broader response as Ebola spreads across three regions.
The Ebola outbreak that began in DR Congo is becoming a continental crisis after authorities initially underestimated its spread, the head of Africa’s public health agency told Semafor as new cases were reported as far afield as Nigeria.
More than 4,600 people have died in the outbreak of the Bundibugyo strain which was first detected in DR Congo in May, though health experts believe it had been circulating undetected for weeks. It has now spread further across Africa than any previous Ebola outbreak, with cases in the continent’s central, eastern and western regions. Nigeria, Africa’s most populous country, confirmed its first case of the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no proven vaccine, despite being absent from the agency’s initial list of 15 countries at risk, he said. Kenya has reported nine cases while Uganda, which recorded 20 cases, was declared free of Ebola in August.

콩고 민주 공화국에서 시작된 에볼라 발병은 당국이 처음에 확산을 과소 평가 한 후 대륙의 위기가되고 있다고 아프리카 공중 보건 기관의 책임자는 Semafor에게 나이지리아만큼 멀리 떨어진 곳에서 새로운 사례가보고되었다고 말했다.
지난 5월 콩고 민주 공화국 (DR Congo) 에서 처음 검출된 분디부교 균주 (Bundibugyo strain) 의 발병으로 4,600명 이상이 사망했지만, 보건 전문가들은 이 균주가 몇 주 동안 발견되지 않은 채 순환해 왔다고 보고 있다. 현재 아프리카 대륙의 중부, 동부 및 서부 지역의 사례와 함께 이전의 에볼라 발병보다 아프리카 전역으로 더 확산되었습니다. 아프리카에서 가장 인구가 많은 나이지리아는 분디부교 균주의 첫 사례를 확인했습니다. 분디부교 균주에는 백신이 없습니다.

body:
Federal officials brushed off the issue as Utah prioritized the fur industry’s interests. Little has been done to stop the spread of the virus and ensure it can’t spread to humans, a failure that experts called “irresponsible’’ and “astounding.”
These highlights were written by the reporters and editors who worked on this story.
The strain of bird flu that’s ripped through American barns for the last four years has killed two people who caught it from sick animals. But as far as anyone can tell, humans can’t spread it. The virus has remained a true “bird” flu, tailored to attach to avian cells, not invade human throats and noses, where coughing and sneezing reliably spew droplets.
Under the right conditions, however, that could change. A single mutation could give the bird flu a foothold in people and spark a pandemic that experts fear could be deadlier than COVID-19.

body:

Post Email Whatsapp Copy link Share The US is offering new support to Kenya and Nigeria in the wake of the African nations reporting a handful of new Ebola cases, as the virus spreads well beyond the initial site of the outbreak.
“The United States is aware of reports of a Kenyan citizen who died of Ebola in Nairobi after traveling there from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as well as reports of additional cases,” a State Department spokesperson told Semafor, adding that the Trump administration “stands ready to support the response in Kenya as needed.”
The US raised its travel advisory for Kenya to Level 3 earlier this week over Ebola, as a rare strain of the virus with no approved vaccine or treatment spreads beyond the center of the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

titleKo: 이번 시즌 조류독감에 걸린 첫 영국 농부의 '충격'
body:
The first farmer in England hit by bird flu this season tells of the "emotional roller coaster" of losing 32,000 hens.
Share Save Add as preferred on Google Malcolm Prior Rural affairs producer A farmer hit by England's first outbreak of avian flu this season has said the loss of 32,000 egg-laying birds is likely to cost her business more than £100,000.
Catherine Armstrong, who has a free-range farm near Belford, Northumberland, told the BBC of the "shock" of her worst fears coming true when she found "a carpet of dead birds" in her barns this week.
The outbreak's source is not yet known but the virus is thought to have been brought onto the site, which has strict biosecurity measures, by wild birds. The farm's remaining poultry were culled.
The Animal and Plant Health Agency (APHA) has put control measures in place to contain the outbreak but warned cases were likely to rise.

이번 시즌 조류 독감에 걸린 영국 최초의 농부는 32,000 마리의 암탉을 잃는 "감정적 인 롤러 코스터" 를 알려줍니다.
공유 저장 Google에서 선호하는 추가 기능 추가 말콤 선행 농촌 문제 생산자 올 시즌 잉글랜드에서 조류 독감이 처음 발생한 농부는 32,000마리의 알을 낳는 새의 손실로 인해 사업 비용이 £ 100,000 이상 소요될 가능성이 높다고 말했습니다.
노섬벌랜드주 벨포드 근처에 무료 농장을 운영하고 있는 캐서린 암스트롱은 이번 주 헛간에서 "죽은 새들의 카펫" 을 발견했을 때의 최악의 두려움에 대한 "충격" 에 대해 BBC에 말했다.
발병 원인은 아직 알려지지 않았지만 이 바이러스는 야생 조류에 의해 엄격한 생체 보안 조치가 있는 현장에 유입된 것으로 추정됩니다. 농장의 남은 가금류는 도살되었다.
동물 및 식물 보건국 (APHA) 은 발병을 억제하기 위해 통제 조치를 취했지만 사례가 증가할 가능성이 있다고 경고했습니다.

body:
Nigeria confirmed its first Ebola case in Abuja on Oct. 20. Here's what it means as the world's fastest-growing outbreak spreads.
The Ebola outbreak devastating the Democratic Republic of the Congo has arrived in West Africa for the first time in more than a decade. Nigerian health authorities confirmed a positive diagnosis in Abuja on October 20, marking the first documented case in Nigeria's capital and the first in the West African region since the catastrophic 2014–2016 epidemic. The announcement reverberated across the international public health community and the broader continent, which is already confronting the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever recorded.
